sources.evidence_scope: Chen source labels, not independent identity truth
sources.limitation: Counts and historical assignments do not establish marker coexpression or biological replication.
Species and stage differences; no one-to-one mapping to Chen fine labels. Source-related sensitivity only.
Main anatomical mapping is mouse; shared FOXA2/LMX1A expression is not uniquely mDA.

sources.evidence_scope: Human astroglial and other broad cortical programs
sources.limitation: Cortical source and maturation comparisons do not validate fetal VM source labels.

sources.evidence_scope: Human brain vascular and immune cell families
sources.limitation: Adult normal/malformed tissue; developmental applicability remains bounded.

sources.locator: Figure 1; Supplementary Figure 1; Extended Data Figure 2
sources.evidence_scope: Human brain vascular programs across developmental/clinical contexts
sources.limitation: Do not pool fetal, adult and disease samples as one developmental baseline.
Mouse stem-cell model; MNX1 absence is not an absolute human OMTN exclusion rule.

sources.evidence_scope: VTA glutamate/GABA single- and dual-transmitter populations
sources.limitation: Mouse VTA; dual-transmitter biology does not validate a zero-observation human reference class.
Fetal cortical source, not independent validation of Chen VM labels.

state_reviews.definition: Astroglial transcriptional family, without a mature-function claim.
state_reviews.rationale: Broad astroglial programs are supported; source labels still need analytical validation.
limitations: Radial-glial and gliogenic transitions share markers.
Literature source is not a matched fetal-VM validation cohort.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Vascular endothelial transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: A coordinated endothelial program is more defensible than any mandatory single marker.
limitations: KDR and EMCN need not occur in every endothelial state.
Developmental and disease contexts must remain separate.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Extracellular-matrix-rich fibroblast-like transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: Broad fibroblast-like identity is supported, without asserting a meningeal or perivascular subtype.
limitations: Only three annotated donors and 161 observations.
Adult vascular evidence does not independently validate fetal-VM labels.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Progenitor-like source group with unresolved neuroepithelial/gliogenic boundary.
state_reviews.rationale: The source marker program overlaps radial glia and does not establish gliogenic identity or malignancy.
limitations: No source-cell discriminator separates this group from radial-glial/gliogenic transitions.
Do not rename or merge the source group as if its identity were established.

state_reviews.definition: Broad immune/blood-related source group whose inclusion boundary is unresolved.
state_reviews.rationale: Myeloid markers cannot establish the full scope of a heterogeneous immune/blood source label.
limitations: The complete historical subgroup cross-tab is not independently reconciled.
Do not relabel the full group as microglia or call erythroid cells immune.

state_reviews.definition: Neuron-committed immature transcriptional family; lineage and stage remain separate.
state_reviews.rationale: Neurogenic progression is supported but does not by itself identify a VM/mDA lineage.
limitations: STMN2 and TUBB3 are not neuroblast-specific.
HES1 detection or nondetection is not an absolute stage boundary.

state_reviews.definition: Cholinergic vocabulary item without current scRNA reference observations.
state_reviews.rationale: Literature cannot supply the absent reference observations or resolve overlap with OMTN.
limitations: Zero annotated donors and observations.
Retain the Neuron_Chat spelling alias without granting availability.

state_reviews.definition: Dopaminergic transcriptional family spanning early and later neuronal stages.
state_reviews.rationale: Coordinated dopaminergic evidence is supported; VM regional identity and intended stage require separate evidence.
limitations: SLC6A3 is maturation-related and not required of every early DA state.
TH or DDC alone is insufficient; no product role is inferred from the label alone.

state_reviews.definition: Neuronal GABA-synthesis and transport transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: The GABA program is supported in neuronal context.
limitations: Coexpressed glutamatergic programs require investigation rather than automatic exclusion.
Dual-transmitter states, transitions, doublets and contamination must be distinguished.
A transmitter program alone does not establish a non-mDA lineage; joint DA and regional evidence is required.

state_reviews.definition: Neuronal vesicular-glutamate transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: Use transmitter machinery, not SATB2, as the broad candidate program.
limitations: SATB2 is not a universal ventral-midbrain glutamatergic identity marker.
GABA coexpression is not automatically an error or an exclusive partition.
A transmitter program alone does not establish a non-mDA lineage; joint DA and regional evidence is required.

state_reviews.definition: Unresolved mixed-transmitter vocabulary item without current scRNA observations.
state_reviews.rationale: Dual-transmitter cells exist, but their biology does not validate this zero-observation human label.
limitations: Zero annotated donors and observations.
Require same-cell/source evidence before distinguishing biology from technical mixture.

state_reviews.definition: Oculomotor/trochlear-like transcriptional family requiring anatomical context.
state_reviews.rationale: OMTN-like programs differ from a generic spinal motor program; MNX1 is not a universal positive discriminator.
limitations: Mouse induced-cell evidence cannot freeze human MNX1-negativity as a hard gate.
CHAT is shared transmitter evidence, not a unique anatomical identifier.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Serotonergic neuronal transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: Coordinated serotonergic machinery supports the broad family.
limitations: DDC is shared with dopaminergic cells.
Any TH signal is competing evidence, not an unconditional rejection rule.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Differentiated oligodendroglial transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: A coordinated myelin-associated program supports a broad descriptive identity.
limitations: Only two annotated donors; independent three-way donor calibration/test support is not estimable for this class.
Expression does not prove myelination function or clinical maturity.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Oligodendroglial progenitor transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: Oligodendroglial lineage evidence must accompany shared precursor markers.
limitations: CSPG4 is also a mural marker and is not sufficient alone.
Early RG–OPC transitions may not express every mature OPC marker.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Pericyte-like mural transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: A coordinated mural program distinguishes candidate pericyte-like cells from vascular confounders.
limitations: No single marker covers all mural states.
Historical RG-to-pericyte conflicts remain excluded.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Radial-glial/progenitor transcriptional family without morphological or fate proof.
state_reviews.rationale: Broad radial-glial programs are supported but overlap other early glial/progenitor families.
limitations: Not a validated discriminator against the Glioblast source group.
A radial-glial label does not establish VM/mDA commitment.

state_reviews.definition: Contractile smooth-muscle-like mural transcriptional family.
state_reviews.rationale: Use the coordinated contractile program with vascular context.
limitations: ACTA2 alone is not specific.
Disease-related endothelial transitions are a confounder, not a fetal normal baseline.
Off-target is a conditional identity policy, not a measured product fraction or a clinical harm claim.

state_reviews.definition: Historical regional source partition; only its broad radial-glial parent is currently supported.
state_reviews.rationale: Use a supported parent rather than turn historical subtype names into anatomical or product-role claims.
limitations: Historical NKX2-1/LMX1A/PAX6 plots do not uniquely establish VM floor-plate or mDA identity.
Listed markers describe the broad parent, not a validated child-state discriminator.
Independent lineage programs and developmental stage must be assessed separately.
